common: Track product prices and stock availability across your watched stores.
Scheduled checks of public product pages. Alerts for confirmed price and stock changes.
position: Your products against confirmed matches on the competitor sites you saved.
Last reading retained; excluded from position.
Price, stock and check time unavailable.

Proposed rule: compare your price with current readings for confirmed matches in the same currency. Include your store in the rank; equal prices share a rank. Difference is your price minus the cheapest price, divided by that price for %. Exclude missing and overdue readings; show no position when no current competitor reading is available. Stock is shown separately.
matches: Same brand and maker part number. No barcode match. Confirm the product before it affects price position.
Suggested matches do not affect price position. Confirm only when the competitor page is the same product. Reject a suggestion when it is a different product.
sites: Sites saved under Source links in Tiger’s Plugins.
Stopped at a human check. Tiger never solves or bypasses it.

Pages checked and matches found refer to the latest site check. Skipped pages are not counted as checked. A human check can stop a run after some pages have been read; robots restrictions can leave other permitted pages readable. Only saved Source links are checked.
